generation.scope: The five central quartics of every regular finite-edge domain limit on the fifteen-dimensional component have exactly four possible image types: a quartic threefold, a quadric threefold, a normal degree-four intersection-of-two-quadrics surface, or a cubic scroll surface. The first three give weighted complete-intersection center presentations including quartic basepoints. In the scroll case the general octic canonical surface has two distinct simple canonical basepoints which are Weierstrass points of every general canonical curve.

open_mathematics: Determine the center over the cubic scroll using its two ramification basepoints, and test exceptional weighted center realizations and the non-domain strata.
